snippet.title: Character Trailer - "Linnea: Precise Answers, Curious Wonders!" | Genshin Impact #Linnea
snippet.description:
The advisor always has answers ready for every question, but as for where she'll be, that's anyone's guess... After all, there's always something extraordinary waiting to be discovered somewhere.
You open up her adventure journal — will today's page contain a record of a rare breakthrough, or just a funny little mishap?

VA:
Katheryne — Erica Mendez
Linnea — Savanna Menzel
Klee — Poonam Basu
Kirara — Julia Gu
Sigewinne — Sarah Williams
Arataki Itto — Max Mittelman
Mualani — Cassandra Lee Morris
